name: railway-gate-route-assistant
description: Intelligent routing system preventing road delays caused by railway level crossing closures

scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix shared run build && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build:backend: npm --prefix shared run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix shared run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
